wholeRequirements.description: Null if no requirements are configured (e.g. no requirements.toml/MDM entries).

boundedObservationRule: After an actual successful requirements response, whole null means no configured requirements. Optional featureRequirements omitted/null/empty reports no additional feature constraint. Missing whole field or missing final RPC/response is insufficient. Invalid/unknown/conflicting present constraints remain nonpositive. Other gates unchanged.
currentExternalDocs: Overseer supplied current documentation corroboration; this package relies on pinned local schema, not an independently refreshed current-doc claim.
